notes.title: Update Ver 1.02
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed as of today's update.

- Fixed several localization bugs for English and French.
- Fixed a bug where clearing an achievement for clearing a certain route under a specific difficulty setting did not trigger successfully.
- Fixed a bug where the player character continues in motion in in-game event cutscenes.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.01
notes.notes:
The following issues have been addressed:

・Fixed a bug that caused characters to behave incorrectly when the application is launched in certain regions.
・Fixed a bug where, during certain events, a character would maintain momentum and continue moving forward.
・Corrected the text in some languages.

notes.title: 【Tips】How do I use various controllers?
notes.notes:
■When using different types of controllers
In the Steam "settings" menu, under the "Controller" tab, turn OFF the following check boxes in the "General Controller Settings" section:

 - PlayStation Configuration Support
 - Xbox Configuration Support
 - Generic Gamepad Configuration Support

■When using the Switch Pro controller
In the Steam "settings" menu, under the "Controller" tab, turn ON the following check box in the "General Controller Settings" section:

 - Switch Pro Configuration Support
